version.changelog: Added security metadata, source references, runtime environment docs, and credential declarations to address ClawHub security review

llm.summary: This is a reference-only documentation skill with no executable behavior, though it includes Telegram-compatible app identifier constants that users should not blindly reuse for deployments.

dimensions.detail: The runtime environment section discusses Teamgram Server components such as MySQL, Redis, etcd, and gateway/session services, but frames them as operator reference information rather than permissions required by the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or binaries, and the inspected artifact includes no install scripts, dependencies, or executable files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are limited to explaining protocol flow, data structures, caching, and source references; they do not direct the agent to run commands, change goals, access data, or contact services.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, privilege escalation path, background worker, credential collection, or local data indexing behavior is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently presents itself as a documentation/knowledge skill for Teamgram MTProto internals and contains only Markdown reference material.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, treat this as developer reference material only. If you operate a compatible server or client, provision your own application identity/configuration instead of relying on the published constants, and do not treat the included values as authorization or user-session credentials.
llm.findings: [T09] expected: The documented APP_ID and APP_HASH appear in a protocol-constants section of a Markdown-only reference skill. This is credential-like deployment configuration and should not be reused blindly, but the artifact does not execute it, transmit it, or use it to access accounts or systems.
